title: A survey of diversity quantification in natural language processing: The why, what, where and how
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not describe a benchmark related to faith or religion. It is a survey on diversity quantification in NLP. One cited work uses Bible translations as a corpus for linguistic diversity in sign language processing, but this is not an evaluation of religious content.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the methods and motivations for quantifying diversity in NLP. It notes one cited paper (Gueuwou et al., 2023) uses a corpus of Bible translations to enhance linguistic diversity for sign language processing, but makes no further analysis of religion.
